set_period_input_auto_range.description: enable/disable autorange of period input voltage

set_resolution.description: set resolution in measurement units (not valid for FREQ/PER/RATIO)

set_measurement_rate.description: set integration time in PLC (DCV, ratio, DCI, 2W, 4W only; default 10)

set_frequency_aperture.description: set frequency gate/aperture time (10 ms=4.5 digits, 100 ms=5.5 digits default, 1 s=6.5 digits)

set_ac_filter_bandwidth.description: select lowest expected input frequency: slow 3 Hz, medium 20 Hz (default), fast 200 Hz

set_autozero.description: set autozero mode (OFF/ONCE stop zeroing until next wait-for-trigger; ON default)

set_input_impedance_auto.description: input resistance auto: >10 GOhm on 100mV/1V/10V DCV ranges when ON, 10 MOhm fixed when OFF

query_input_impedance_auto.description: query input resistance mode, returns 0 (OFF) or 1 (ON)

query_trigger_source.description: query trigger source, returns BUS, IMM or EXT

set_trigger_count.description: number of triggers before returning to idle (1-50000, INFinite = continuous)

set_trigger_delay.description: trigger delay in seconds (0-3600); selecting a value turns auto delay OFF

set_trigger_delay_auto.description: automatic trigger delay based on function/range/integration/filter

query_trigger_delay_auto.description: query automatic trigger delay, returns 0 (OFF) or 1 (ON)

initiate_measurement.description: arm: idle -> wait-for-trigger; readings stored in internal memory (max 512)

read_measurement.description: arm and take measurement, readings sent directly to output buffer (INITiate + FETCh? in one)

fetch_readings.description: transfer readings stored by INITiate to output buffer

query_reading_count.description: number of readings stored in internal memory

set_reading_memory.description: store INITiate readings in memory (CALCulate) or not (empty string)

query_reading_memory.description: query reading memory state, returns CALC or empty string

set_math_function.description: select math function (only one at a time, default NULL)

query_math_function.description: query math function, returns NULL, DB, DBM, AVER or LIM

set_nulls.description: store null value (0 to +/-120% of highest range; math must be ON)

query_min_max_minimum.description: minimum value found during min-max operation

query_min_max_maximum.description: maximum value found during min-max operation

query_min_max_average.description: average of all readings since min-max enabled

query_min_max_count.description: number of readings since min-max enabled

set_db_reference.description: dB relative reference (-200 to +200 dBm; math must be ON)

set_limit_low.description: set lower limit for limit test (0 to +/-120% of highest range)

set_limit_high.description: set upper limit for limit test (0 to +/-120% of highest range)

display_text.description: display a message on front panel (12 chars max)

query_display_text.description: query the displayed message, returns quoted string

enable_questionable_register.description: enable bits in Questionable Data enable register

query_questionable_event.description: query Questionable Data event register (clears it)

status_preset.description: clear all bits in Questionable Data enable register

calibration_query.description: perform calibration using the value set by set_calibration_value (requires unsecured)

query_calibration_count.description: number of times instrument has been calibrated (non-volatile)

set_calibration_code.description: set new security code (up to 12 chars; must unsecure first)

query_calibration_string.description: query calibration message, returns quoted string

set_calibration_value.description: specify value of the known calibration signal

interface.notes: Una sola interfaccia attiva alla volta, selezionata dal menu front-panel I/O. Su RS-232 supportato solo SCPI. SYSTem:LOCal/REMote/RWLock validi su entrambe.

capabilities.max_reading_rate: 1000 readings/s (4.5 digits, 0.02 PLC, autozero OFF, display OFF)
capabilities.notes: FREQ/PER usano un unico range per tutto il band (3 Hz-300 kHz); i comandi RANGe/RESolution si riferiscono alla tensione di ingresso (FREQuency:VOLTage/PERiod:VOLTage).
